calls.title: gensan thomson and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around Masterclass's budget concerns triggered by a renewal price increase from $40,500 to $160,000. Cary Rakin from Growth Book cited rapid scaling as the reason for the hike, while Matt Elgie expressed that even a smaller increase would be a challenge for their budget. Masterclass typically expects annual increases of around 10-15%. Growth Book proposed a phased pricing structure, beginning with $80,000 this year and increasing to $160,000 next year, alongside a two-year contract. Masterclass is open to adjusting user seats but aims to maintain platform usage. Both parties emphasized the importance of aligning the platform's features with Masterclass's needs, and they agreed to keep the partnership robust with future communication on feature enablement and quarterly reviews.
calls.keywords: Renewal, Pricing Negotiation, Experimentation Platform, Budget Constraints, Feature Adoption, Contract Terms

calls.summary:
# gensan thomson and Chris Sanders + Cary Rakin
Date: 2026-11-23 | Duration: 21.450000762939453m

## Summary
GrowthBook supports the customer’s flags, experiments, feature rollouts, and related processes, while the customer’s internal systems handle experiment analytics and data pipelines. The customer is evaluating enterprise self-hosting because GrowthBook’s cloud features may exceed current usage and pricing has increased from $45,000 to $75,000 annually, with approximately $130,000 discussed for the next year pending verification. Self-hosted deployment is expected to provide feature parity, including flagging, single sign-on, and rollouts, but the customer would manage its own infrastructure, and major savings are not guaranteed because platform innovation and maintenance costs remain. The customer already caches data through Redis and its CDN, while GrowthBook’s proxy could provide another caching layer. GrowthBook may consider covering additional request or bandwidth costs beyond the included 10 million monthly requests. No renewal or migration decision was made; Cary Rakin will seek leadership approval and return with a more predictable commercial proposal.

## Keywords
Enterprise self-hosting, Renewal pricing, Feature flags, Experimentation, CDN proxy, Cost optimisation
